resources.string: Save music volume and default key and tempo to a file. Choose Google Drive if it appears in the Android file picker, or save on this device. KANTA does not sign in or sync automatically. The file is not encrypted and does not contain songs, your library, or account details.
This replaces your music volume and default key and tempo. It does not change your songs, queue, or settings saved for individual songs.
Finish or stop the current song before using settings backup. Pausing is not enough.
